about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I am a software engineer focused on designing and building reliable, scalable, and well-crafted digital products in complex, high-impact environments, including enterprise platforms, banking systems, and consumer-facing applications.

My experience spans native iOS development, modern frontend technologies, and backend service integration, allowing me to contribute beyond feature delivery — from architecture discussions and system design to performance optimization, accessibility, and long-term maintainability.

I thrive in collaborative environments where engineering, product, and design intersect. I am known for adapting quickly to new stacks and domains while maintaining a strong engineering mindset centered on quality, clarity, and delivering real value to users.

items.title: Network Intelligence Platform
items.subtitle: ISP · Infrastructure · IP Asset Management
items.description: Enterprise internal systems designed to centralize IP address management, automate network visibility, and regain operational control across a rapidly growing ISP.

sections.content: Eninetworks was a rapidly growing wireless ISP providing connectivity to regions where fiber infrastructure was not available. The accelerated growth exposed critical operational gaps in IP address management, network visibility, and internal coordination.

Core network operations relied on shared Excel files to manage IP allocations, customer assignments, and infrastructure planning. This caused duplicated IP usage, inactive clients consuming resources, lack of traceability, and severe operational risk as the network scaled nationwide.

I designed and developed a set of internal platforms to replace Excel-based workflows with centralized, role-based systems that provided real-time visibility, automated reporting, and structured network data across all regions.

bullets: Modeling a nationwide ISP infrastructure hierarchy (regions, nodes, sectors, segments, IPs)
Ensuring data consistency and traceability across thousands of network assets
Integrating third-party network equipment data using SNMP
Automating data collection across VPN-connected remote nodes
Designing secure role-based access for multiple departments
Recovered control over IP address allocation and customer assignments
Identified inactive clients and unauthorized IP usage
Eliminated Excel as the source of truth across NOC, Core IP, and Infrastructure teams
Enabled real-time reporting and data-driven network decisions
Improved operational coordination across multiple regions nationwide
